verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a data-integration platform, so the story applies, but no evidence shows a native bulk-action capability such as selecting many connections to sync, edit or delete at once. The Airbyte API, Terraform provider and PyAirbyte are developer building blocks that could be scripted to approximate bulk changes, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
